mysql --batch --raw --column-names --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --host gateway02.us-east-1.prod.aws.tidbcloud.com --port 4000 --user ogmtopKka7VLP2a.root --database LV5DDS56NhvJNRfavaEMZ5 --execute 
SELECT p.id as pkg_id, p.packageType, p.totalHours as total_min, p.usedHours as used_min, p.isActive, p.startDate, p.endDate,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.durationMinutes),0) FROM attendances a WHERE a.packageId = p.id AND a.attendanceType = 'normal' AND a.durationMinutes IS NOT NULL) as real_sum_min
FROM packages p WHERE p.residentId = 60001 ORDER BY p.startDate;
